baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَاوَدَتْهُ ... عَن نَّفْسِهِ within her house, followed by repeated closing of the entrances and هَيْتَ لَكَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The solicitation contests another will; control of the dwelling supplies positional power, closing every entrance removes routes of refusal, and the final summons presses the target's very self rather than merely offering private intimacy.

activation_trace.role: Contested solicitation supplies pressure directed at changing another person's will.
The dwelling is shelter but also the controlled site that gives its resident positional power.
The self as the person's very identity makes his agency, not only his appetite, the object sought.
Coercive tightening turns the emphatic closing into a restriction on his capacity to act.
Entrances are literal spatial channels whose closure constructs the no-exit pressure.
The direct summons supplies the demanded approach at the end of the spatial constriction.

changed_reading.before: A woman creates privacy for a seduction.
changed_reading.after: A household superior engineers a no-exit solicitation that presses the resident's agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِنَّهُ رَبِّي أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَايَ read with رَبِّي as the human master or patron.
baseline_models.mechanism: On the human-referent reading, mastery is qualified by benefaction and good lodging: the protected resident owes fidelity to a host-patron relation, while the demand would place that relation in the wrong moral location and convert hospitality into betrayal.

activation_trace.role: Mastery and ownership keep a human patron as a live antecedent of رَبِّي.
Benefaction beyond bare justice makes the good lodging an ethical obligation rather than decor.
Lodging, guest, and householder imagery frames his station as entrusted hospitality.
Putting something in the wrong place makes the demanded act a corruption of the host-resident relation.

changed_reading.before: The lodging clause is an incidental reminder of kindness.
changed_reading.after: On the human-master reading, good lodging creates a hospitality trust that the demand would violently misplace.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ رَبِّي أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَايَ read as one continuous divine relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Refuge, divine lordship, nurturing care, benefaction, and stable emplacement form one causal line: the Lord who gives shelter is also the one whose protection and ordering Yusuf invokes against violating that shelter.

activation_trace.role: Seeking protective shelter makes the utterance an act of attachment to a guarding power.
The worshipped God identifies the refuge as vertical allegiance rather than merely self-command.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion let رَبِّي name the care that formed his station.
Active benefaction supplies the goodness attributed to that divine care.
Stable residence makes his present emplacement part of the care he refuses to violate.

changed_reading.before: He utters a protective formula and then separately mentions lodging.
changed_reading.after: On the divine-Lord reading, refuge, nurture, and good emplacement are one relation of dependence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing verdict لَا يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ after the self has been solicited and the entrances closed.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wrongdoing can be imaged as putting a person or act where it does not belong and withholding a right; flourishing can carry both durable success and making an opening. The aphorism then says that enclosing another self cannot generate a rightful opening or lasting good.

activation_trace.role: The person's very self identifies the right-bearing object placed under pressure.
Splitting or opening supplies a spatial counter-image to the preceding sealed entrances.
Durable victory and survival turn that opening into an enduring rather than momentary good.
Wrong placement makes coercive intimacy a violation of proper relational location.
Withholding and confinement from a right identify the agency denied by the enclosure.

changed_reading.after: No durable opening can arise from misplacing another's self under constraint and withholding its right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding movement from hidden merchandise through cheap sale, purchase, projected acquisition, and household placement, followed by the public label of dependent youth, makes solicitation of his self look like an attempted extension of proprietary access into bodily access.

activation_trace.role: Contested solicitation names the later attempt to obtain an act from him.
His very person is the object whose treatment shifts from exchange to demanded access.
A cut-off portion made into trade goods supplies the initial commodification of the recovered boy.
Sale and purchase place his transfer inside an exchange relation.
Diminution of due worth makes the exchange a prior denial of his proper value or right.
Taking or acquiring supplies the household's projected claim to make him useful or a son.
The youth term's servant or enslaved-person scope keeps dependency and unequal household status active.

structural_cues: 12:19-21 move Yusuf through concealment as goods, sale, purchase, projected usefulness or sonship, and placement in the purchaser's household.
12:30 retells the focus event as the powerful man's wife soliciting her own dependent youth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a commodity chain and a subordinate household designation; I infer that the later demand repeats a proprietary logic across domains. A live alternative is genuine passion operating inside, but not because of, that ownership structure.

changed_reading.before: The approach is a personal act of illicit attraction.
changed_reading.after: The approach also attempts to treat a purchased dependent's self as another household asset available for use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The instruction to honor Yusuf's lodging supports the human-benefactor reading, while repeated divine ر ب ب around the scene and the distinct title for the husband weight رَبِّي toward God. Context therefore sharpens, but does not erase, the focus clause's double ethical alignment.

activation_trace.role: The branch spans divine Lord and human master, preserving both possible antecedents in the focus.
Honorable generosity supplies the human patron's command to treat Yusuf's lodging well.
The repeated lodging term directly links the patron's instruction to Yusuf's gratitude clause.
Lordship attached to the seen proof supplies an unmistakably divine use immediately after the focus.
The husband's separate title of social mastery differentiates him from the nearby divine Lord vocabulary.
Direct prayer to رَبِّ restores the divine address in Yusuf's own speech.
His Lord's response confirms the divine relation developed by the later prayer.

structural_cues: 12:21 and 12:23 repeat the same lodging lexeme across the patron's instruction and Yusuf's explanation.
12:24, 12:33, and 12:34 use ر ب ب in divine frames, whereas 12:25 names the husband with a different mastery title.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lodging echo, repeated divine ر ب ب, and a separate human title; I infer contextual weighting toward God without treating distribution as syntactic proof. The human patron, the divine Lord, or a compressed resonance of both remain live.

changed_reading.before: رَبِّي must have one obvious referent.
changed_reading.after: The clause can bind gratitude to the household benefactor and reliance on the divine Lord, with context weighting the latter but preserving both.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closed entrances become a raced-for exit; pursuit leaves a longitudinal tear from behind, and the garment becomes a witnessing mark. Yusuf's verbal refuge is therefore retroactively read as embodied non-consent moving toward escape.

activation_trace.role: The focus entrances begin as controlled barriers that can later become the route of escape.
Racing and striving to precede convert verbal refusal into opposed bodily motion.
The repeated entrance becomes both their destination and the place where the private scene meets an external witness.
A lengthwise tear records force applied during pursuit rather than consensual stillness.
The back supplies directional evidence that Yusuf was moving away from the pursuer.
A witnessing sign turns the garment's material state into inspectable testimony.

structural_cues: The plural closed entrances in 12:23 narrow to a repeatedly named singular entrance in 12:25.
12:25-28 repeat garment, tear, back, seeing, truth, and falsehood until movement becomes forensic evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies closure, a race, a rear tear, and witness reasoning; I infer that direction of damage retroactively verifies enacted flight. A live alternative is that the focus speech is complete moral evidence on its own and the later garment only adjudicates the public dispute.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf gives a verbal refusal inside sealed privacy.
changed_reading.after: His refuge already initiates a refusal oriented toward exit, later inscribed as evidence on the back of his garment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root field moves from her attempt to bend his will, to her accusation that he intended harm, and back to his statement that she solicited him. Intention is not only disputed; its grammatical ownership becomes the first object of narrative struggle.

activation_trace.role: Solicitation against another will fixes her as the initial agent and him as the pressured object.
Will and intention are reassigned to Yusuf inside her immediate accusation of intended harm.
Yusuf's counterstatement restores solicitation to her agency and his self as its target.

structural_cues: 12:23 names her as subject of solicitation; 12:25 makes him the alleged subject of harmful intention; 12:26 restores her as subject of solicitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rapid subject-role reversal within one root field; I infer that control of the event begins as control of who is said to have willed what. A live alternative is that the shared root is ordinary juridical phrasing without deliberate echo.

changed_reading.before: Her solicitation is followed by a separate false accusation.
changed_reading.after: The focus identifies the intention that she will immediately seize, invert, and assign to him, forcing his reply to recover both agency and grammar.

context_deltas.mechanism: Her later admission joins solicitation, his active self-protection, her command, imprisonment, and humiliation in one conditional threat. This makes the focus enclosure the first instrument in a coercive continuum rather than a neutral device for privacy.

activation_trace.role: Coercive closure supplies the first restriction on Yusuf's freedom of action.
The summons becomes the first demand in the later command-and-punishment sequence.
Her own admission confirms that she attempted to turn him toward the requested act.
Protective holding and prevention identify his response as active resistance.
An enforcing demand reveals that compliance, not mutual invitation, is the operative goal.
Confinement supplies the threatened institutional consequence of refusing the command.
Humiliation names the status degradation attached to continued noncompliance.

structural_cues: 12:32 puts solicitation, resistance, command, prison, and abasement into one speech by the woman.
The focus's controlled house and entrances precede an explicit appeal to external carceral power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies her admission and conditional punishment; I infer continuity between room-scale enclosure and institution-scale confinement. A live alternative is that the doors initially seek secrecy and become coercive only when the later threat is uttered.

changed_reading.before: The locked room intensifies a private temptation.
changed_reading.after: The locked room is the first scale of an enforceable demand whose next scales are prison and social abasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus refuge unfolds as perception of proof, divine diversion, active self-protection, confessed susceptibility to inclination, prayer, and response. مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ is thus an enacted dependence that does not deny vulnerability.

activation_trace.role: Protective attachment supplies the initial act whose later stages the context displays.
Perception by eye or insight gives the refuge a disclosed object of attention.
Demonstrative proof supplies the cognitive support seen in the moment of pressure.
Turning something from its course supplies divine redirection away from evil and indecency.
Holding fast so as to prevent harm supplies Yusuf's active participation in protection.
The heart's possible inclination makes susceptibility explicit rather than projecting effortless invulnerability.
Agitated loss of forbearance names the feared state that divine turning must prevent.
Answering speech makes the appeal relational and effective rather than a solitary slogan.
Completed redirection supplies the narrated answer to the vulnerability admitted in prayer.

structural_cues: 12:24 attributes diversion from evil to divine action, while 12:32 attributes active self-protection to Yusuf.
12:33 conditionally admits possible inclination without divine turning, and 12:34 narrates an answer and that turning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proof, resistance, possible inclination, petition, response, and diversion; I infer that مَعَاذَ begins a cooperative sequence of human clinging and divine protection. A live alternative is that the focus phrase functions chiefly as an absolute prohibition, with vulnerability disclosed only later.

changed_reading.before: An invulnerable moral hero reflexively dismisses temptation.
changed_reading.after: Yusuf seeks and receives protection while actively resisting and candidly depending on help against a live capacity to incline.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sealed private scene is followed by an order to turn away and cover the offense, then by circulating speech and a staged appearance that produces collective bodily reaction. Secrecy fails and is converted into managed spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Emphatic physical closure supplies the scene's initial attempt at controlled privacy.
Turning aside supplies the household instruction to suppress further engagement with the exposed event.
Protective covering supplies the attempted containment of the acknowledged offense and its effects.
Speech circulating among people turns a closed-room event into city-wide reputation.
Public report and notoriety make the circulating judgment actionable for the woman.
Emergence into an outside space turns Yusuf into the displayed center of a prepared gathering.
Physical cutting supplies the involuntary collective reaction that the staged display elicits.

structural_cues: 12:29 attempts to end and cover the affair; 12:30 shows it circulating through the city; 12:31 answers gossip with a prepared visual demonstration.
The woman's control shifts from doors and private speech to invitations, props, command, display, and an audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted suppression, social circulation, and a prepared display; I infer that private control is repurposed as control of the public gaze. A live alternative is that the gathering is primarily reputation defense rather than a further extension of coercion.

changed_reading.before: The focus is one woman's hidden proposition.
changed_reading.after: The closed-room proposition begins a secrecy-reputation loop that later turns Yusuf into the object of a managed collective gaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The authorities can recognize signs and still imprison Yusuf for a delimited time. Their immediate capacity to close him away does not refute the focus verdict; it distinguishes temporary efficacy from the durable survival and good named by flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Enduring victory and survival make flourishing a long-horizon measure rather than one successful maneuver.
Withholding a person from his right identifies confinement after evidence as the operative wrong.
Emergence into visibility establishes that the decision follows disclosure rather than ignorance.
Visible signs supply acknowledged evidence that fails to prevent the unjust decision.
Institutional confinement supplies the wrongdoers' real but provisional tactical success.
A bounded time marks that success as temporary rather than durable flourishing.

structural_cues: 12:35 explicitly places the prison decision after signs have been seen.
The confinement is grammatically bounded by an unspecified but finite time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognized signs, unjust confinement, and a time limit; I infer a distinction between short-term power and lasting flourishing. A live alternative is that the focus maxim is purely general and need not predict any temporal pattern in this episode.

changed_reading.before: The maxim promises that the coercive scheme will fail immediately.
changed_reading.after: Wrongdoers may secure temporary closure even after truth appears, but that maneuver is not the durable good or survival called flourishing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The low or hidden-place branch of هَيْتَ is surprising because it is topographic and partly toponymic, not a warranted translation of the summons. It remains anchored by هَيْتَ itself and the dense house, narrow-place, and closed-entrance cluster; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial echo that deepens concealment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: هَيْتَ inside فِي بَيْتِهَا ... غَلَّقَتِ الْأَبْوَابَ.

activation_trace.role: A low, obscure place lets the invitation's sound echo the hidden spatial arrangement without replacing its summons sense.
The dwelling supplies the concrete enclosure in which the unusual spatial echo can attach.
A constricted place intensifies the lowered and hidden quality of the invitation scene.
Controlled entrances keep the spatial resonance visibly tied to the focus construction.

changed_reading.before: هَيْتَ is only the verbal climax of the proposition.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the summons also sounds like the deepest point of the hidden, constricted space she has made.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's non-dominant ر د د mapping for focus ر و د, so it must not be presented as the lexical meaning of رَاوَدَتْ. It remains valid as a split-root resonance because the focus immediately answers solicitation with counter-speech; downstream prose should qualify it as a return-and-rebuff pattern, not etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَاوَدَتْهُ followed by قَالَتْ ... قَالَ and Yusuf's refusal.

activation_trace.role: Turning away and preventing supply a latent counter-motion to the pressure of solicitation.
Rejecting what is unacceptable gives the counter-motion the form of a returned proposal.
Repetition and unsettled back-and-forth image the clash between her attempted redirection and his refusal.
Two-sided speaking supplies the visible exchange through which the pressure is sent back.

changed_reading.before: She proposes and he independently refuses.
changed_reading.after: As a split-root resonance, her attempt generates a return circuit in which his speech sends the pressured will back and refuses its claim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sexual-body branch attached to the earlier merchandise root is cross-domain and should not make the merchandise word itself a sexual term in translation. It remains worth carrying because the packet first makes Yusuf goods and the focus later makes his self the target of solicitation; downstream prose should render only an ominous commodity-to-access resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَاوَدَتْهُ ... عَن نَّفْسِهِ after Yusuf has been concealed and transferred as merchandise.

activation_trace.role: Contested sexual solicitation supplies the later domain into which the earlier commodity image resonates.
The person's very self prevents the resonance from collapsing him into either merchandise or body part.
A portion converted into trade goods supplies the explicit commodity pole of the overlap.
The euphemistic sexual-body or intercourse branch lets the commodity term cast a disturbing shadow toward later demanded access.
Completed exchange keeps the unusual overlap anchored in Yusuf's actual transfer between owners.

changed_reading.before: The sale and the later sexual demand are separate events.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch resonance, the earlier conversion of Yusuf into goods casts the later demand as an attempted conversion of purchase into sexual access.

strongest_changes: The locked-room scene changed from private seduction to engineered coercion aimed at a dependent person's agency.
The merchandise-sale-household chain made the solicitation readable as proprietary access crossing into bodily access.
The human-master and divine-Lord readings of رَبِّي remain coexisting, while later lexical distribution weights the divine reading.
مَعَاذَ اللَّهِ changed from effortless invulnerability to active, vulnerable, and answered dependence.
The later prison decision changed لَا يُفْلِحُ from an immediate-failure promise into a distinction between temporary power and durable flourishing.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made spatial closure, ownership, hospitality, grammar of intention, bodily evidence, public spectacle, and carceral power converge on one focus scene without requiring a single final interpretation. Split mappings also preserved a qualified return-and-rebuff resonance that a conservative reading would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of رَبِّي remains genuinely double: human benefactor, divine Lord, or compressed resonance of both.
The commodity mechanism is structurally strong, but how intentionally the focus activates ownership logic rather than merely inheriting it from context remains uncertain.
The exact relation between human intention, perceived proof, and divine diversion in 12:24 should remain open rather than be harmonized.
The opening sense of ف ل ح and the low-place sense of ه ي ت are valid exploratory echoes, not translation-level claims.
The public gathering can be read as extended coercive display or as reputation management, and both functions may coexist.
